verdict.line: You lose if Volibear lands Q into a double W before level 6; you win if you reach your Shadowflame/Rabadon's spike with HP to spare.

brief.thesis: Volibear's solo-kill advantage is real and concentrated in one combo: Q (Thundering Smash) stuns on arrival, then W (Frenzied Maul) recast on the same target deals bonus damage and heals him, and Gwen has no stun immunity or hard engage to answer it before level 6. The 52.5% win rate over 920 games isn't a flat lane win - it's Gwen surviving that window with Hallowed Mist and Skip 'n Slash, then out-scaling him once her true-damage snips and core items come online.

theirWindow.what: Q (Thundering Smash) stuns the first thing he attacks after he gains speed, confirming a double W (Frenzied Maul) for bonus damage plus a heal. This is where his solo-kill advantage lives - don't contest flat trades, just hold range and potion up.

yourWindow.when: After level 6, his Q on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Dash in with E (Skip 'n Slash) for the attack speed and magic on-hit window, land Q (Snip Snip!) snips for the true-damage center hit, then disengage with R (Needlework) chip damage before his 12-10s Q comes back up.

powerCurve.note: Q stun threatens any early trade
Q into double W can kill
Mist and R stabilize the lane
True-damage snips shred his health pool

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Run by 51.3% of players over 922 games at 82.3% pick rate. Two potions let you hold flat trades through the level 2-5 all-in window until Hallowed Mist (22-18s cooldown) is actually up to disengage with.

boots.why: 56.2% win rate over 276 games. Tenacity cuts into his Q stun duration and blunts the W slow stacking, giving you a real window to break off before he gets the double W recast.

core.why: First item in the 56.8% win rate path (190 games, 30.8% pick) - the mana and ability haste keep your Q and E on their fastest cooldowns through his all-in windows.
Amplifies the true-damage center snip of Q (Snip Snip!) and the burst on A Thousand Cuts, which is what actually punishes his health-based passive scaling.
Turns your passive execute damage into a real burst threat by the time you're fully online, which is where the power curve flips to your favor.

situational.when: the game goes past roughly 30 minutes and you need omnivamp sustain in extended skirmishes
he starts stacking health or magic resist to survive your true-damage snips
you need Grievous Wounds early to shut down his W (Frenzied Maul) recast heal
you're ahead and want to snowball attack speed off your E (Skip 'n Slash) window

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks off repeated Q snips and E autos in extended trades, converting into a heal that offsets exactly the kind of sustained poke Volibear applies with W - and it's the highest-pick-rate keystone in the data at 31.8%.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport posts a 60.5% win rate, well above Flash+Ignite's 49.9%. Given the defensive shape of this matchup, Teleport lets you play the early levels passively without losing tempo on resets, rather than forcing Ignite trades you're not favored to win.

playing.title: Hold Mist for his all-in, not poke
playing.detail: Save Hallowed Mist for when he commits Q into a double W, not to trade back chip damage - that combo is where his solo-kill advantage actually comes from.

playing.title: Respect Q range before level 6
playing.detail: Thundering Smash has 300 range and gains him speed toward you - stay outside it until you have Mist up to answer the stun confirm.

playing.title: Trade only when his Q is down
playing.detail: Dash in with Skip 'n Slash during his Q's 12-10s cooldown window, stack Snip Snip! hits, then retreat before it's back up.

playing.title: Back off after his first W hit
playing.detail: The real damage and heal come from the W recast on the same target - breaking line of sight after the first hit denies the bonus entirely.

playing.title: Use R to poke from outside his range
playing.detail: Needlework reaches 1200 range and slows - chip him down and build passive stacks without ever entering his 300-325 range engage tools.

playing.title: Don't stand in extended melee pre-6
playing.detail: You have no stun immunity or hard disengage before Needlework - disengage rather than matching his sustained W-W pressure.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, runes, summoners, and every win-rate and pick-rate number here come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls on how to play around his combo are my own read of the kit.
